CustomField.description: Formula field determining the winning team based on final scores
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Completed"), IF( Home_Score_Final__c > Away_Score_Final__c, Home_Team__r.Name, IF( Away_Score_Final__c > Home_Score_Final__c, Away_Team__r.Name, "Draw" ) ), "" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows winning team name, Draw, or blank if match not complete
CustomField.label: Winner
